title: Jeevan Yudh
desc: In order to find his father's killer, Rohit goes back to his hometown. When he meets the new police officer, he unravels a dark truth.

title: Satru Mitra
desc: A happy family goes through various trials and tribulations and falls apart when greed takes precedence over relationships.

title: Jwar Bhata
desc: Bijay, a rich tea estate owner's son, angers his father when he marries a poor girl. Ranjan, his cousin, tries to make the most of the situation by usurping his property.

title: Boumar Banabash
desc: A royal couple faces divine punishment as the wife endures exile while the prince grapples with a mysterious curse that threatens both love and destiny.

title: Ekanto Apon
desc: Sudipa falls in love with Ranobir, a goon, and soon, they both get married. However, things take a turn when Ranobir is arrested and gets imprisoned.
